offence_category.quote: the homicide in the present case thus does not amount to murder in the view of Exception 2 to Section 300
offence_category.reason: Murder conviction was set aside; the established offence is culpable homicide under s.304.

statutory_provisions.correct_value: IPC ss.302 and 304 r/w s.34; s.307 r/w s.34 (co-accused); s.97; s.300 Exceptions 2 and 4
statutory_provisions.quote: Penal Code, 1860 - ss.302 and 304 r/w s.34
statutory_provisions.reason: Omits s.307 r/w s.34 for the co-accused and the s.97 and s.300 exceptions discussed.

weapon.correct_value: .32 bore Smith & Wesson revolver; ballistics could not determine which weapon the appellant used
weapon.quote: It is thus not possible to determine the weapon that was used by the appellant.

aggravating_circumstances.reason: No aggravating circumstances are formally found; the prosecution's undue-advantage argument was rejected.

trial_court_outcome.correct_value: Convicted under ss.302 and 304 r/w s.34 IPC (appellant); co-accused convicted under s.307 r/w s.34
trial_court_outcome.quote: The Sessions Court convicted the appellant for the murder of Shyam Sunder under Sections 302 and 304
trial_court_outcome.reason: Conviction was under ss.302 and 304 r/w s.34, not simply murder; co-accused convicted under s.307.

high_court_outcome.correct_value: High Court dismissed appeals, upholding conviction under ss.302 and 304 r/w s.34

high_court_outcome.reason: The High Court decided the appeal and the State's appeal was dismissed; the outcome is not 'Not applicable'.

final_outcome.correct_value: Partly allowed: s.302 conviction set aside; s.304 conviction maintained; sentenced to period undergone
final_outcome.quote: we allow this appeal partly and modify the impugned judgment
final_outcome.reason: Appeal was partly allowed; the appellant was not acquitted, as s.304 conviction was maintained.

offence_finally_established.correct_value: Culpable homicide not amounting to murder under s.304 IPC (death of Shyam Sunder)
offence_finally_established.quote: the appellant is undoubtedly guilty of causing death to Shyam Sunder ... guilty of the offence under Section 304 of the IPC
offence_finally_established.reason: Section 304 offence was established for Shyam Sunder's death, so 'None' is contradicted.
